title: Roth vs Traditional: one decision
hook: Roth or Traditional? One number decides.

concepts.title: The only question: tax rate now or later?
concepts.body: Both accounts have the same $7,500 contribution limit for 2026. The only difference is when you pay tax. Traditional: deduct now, pay at withdrawal. Roth: pay now, withdraw tax-free.

concepts.title: Pay now if you expect a higher tax rate later
concepts.body: If your tax rate in retirement will be higher than today's, Roth wins. The dollars you contribute are after-tax, so a 24% marginal rate today is locked in. Retire at 35%? Roth pays you back.

concepts.title: Deduct now if your rate drops in retirement
concepts.body: If your tax rate in retirement will be lower than today's, Traditional wins. The deduction saves you today's higher rate, and the lower retirement rate applies to withdrawals.
